generations.name: 1. Generation (E2)
generations.notes: Official VW figures (volkswagen.at): length 4,584 mm without tow hitch, width 1,852 mm without mirrors, height 1,616 mm without roof rails, wheelbase 2,771 mm, luggage 543 l / 1,575 l. Other sources give different heights depending on roof rails and wheels: auto motor und sport 1,631 mm (1,640 mm for the Pro), ADAC 1,634 mm for the BLACK EDITION from 03/26. ADAC lists 4,582 mm length and 2,769 mm wheelbase for the Pro 4MOTION 06/22-10/23. Market launch 12/2020 (ADAC generation start). Dimensions and trunk did not change with the 2023 update (MY24: new APP550 motor, 286/340 PS) or the 03/2026 update (MY27: 58 kWh LFP Pure, 190 PS). No frunk. Trunk 543/1,575 l is confirmed for Pure, the 77 kWh variants, GTX 4MOTION and BLACK EDITION, so it is set for all variants, 4MOTION included. Successor: ID. Tiguan, world premiere 9 Oct 2026, market launch 2027, so outside this range. Preliminary ID. Tiguan data from dealer/press sources: 4,618 x 1,855 x 1,619 mm, wheelbase 2,765 mm, 534 l + 32 l frunk, up to 1,577 l.

data.notes:
IMPORTANT: The shared WebSearch budget for this turn (200 calls across all agents) ran out after about 15 searches by this agent. Figures with a URL in sources came from search results (official VW Austria pages, the ADAC Autokatalog, auto motor und sport, InsideEVs, autohaus, carwow and others). Some figures are VW manufacturer data I know but could not check against a source this session; each variant/generation 'notes' field marks them. They matter most for the ID. Buzz short wheelbase dimensions and 2,205 l, the Caddy short wheelbase of 2,755 mm, and most power ratings outside the ID.4. Please spot-check these before release.

Modelling choices:
- ID. Buzz short/long wheelbase, Multivan short/long overhang and Caddy/Caddy Maxi are separate models, because length and trunk differ.
- For the 7-seat vans (ID. Buzz long wheelbase, Multivan, Caddy), trunkL is the volume behind the 2nd row; the 3rd-row value is in notes.
- Caddy volumes are roof-high values, not up to the parcel shelf.

ID.4 successor ID. Tiguan premiered on 9 Oct 2026 with market launch in 2027, outside this range and not included. Preliminary data: 4,618 x 1,855 x 1,619 mm, wheelbase 2,765 mm, 534 l + 32 l frunk, 1,577 l maximum.

Possibly missing van models in the same segment (not researched): Caravelle (T6.1 until 2024 / new Caravelle from 2025), Multivan T6.1 (MY2020-2021), Caddy 4 (MY2020).
